Surface with plain/outline/raised, OutlineSurface and RaisedSurface wrappers, 6 stories, 9 tests, registry entry. Reviewed by taste/correctness/design; only finding was the missing dev warning on unknown prop values, fixed here with src/lib/classes.ts. Commit 0db35d3.
shipped Skeleton, Separator and EmptyState with source, registry entries, stories and tests; fixed sanitize/NaN/aria/props-order findings from review
centered EmptyState title/description (H3 align center, Text align center) so wrapping long titles stay centered; per design review of bbk-rar.5 captures

Button in four forms and three sizes, min-height so long labels grow, wrap-anywhere so an unbreakable word cannot spill, focus ring on focus-visible only. Found and fixed: Tailwind v4 outline-none sets --tw-outline-style:none, which silently killed the focus-visible ring.

Card is a raised Surface laid out as a column, with CardMedia, CardTitle (no heading of its own), CardBody (takes leftover height so footers line up) and CardFooter. Surface gained asChild, which Card and ListItem both need. CardMedia bleeds with first:/last: so it takes whichever edges it is next to.

CardLink covers the Card with an ::after overlay, so the whole card is clickable, tags inside still take their own clicks, and there is one link in the accessibility tree. Focus ring goes on the overlay. CardFooter now sets position: relative so the things that are usually clickable sit above the overlay without the caller knowing it is there.

ListItem is an <li> built on a plain Surface, positioned so CardLink works inside a row. CardListItem is the named raised wrapper. Noticed while looking: plain and raised rows are near-identical against the page — filed as bbk-2vw under step 4.5.

List owns the gap, header, loading, empty and error, in that precedence. Renders every item — 40 rows are 40 rows — and keeps the header in all four states, with placeholder rows holding a list-shaped height while loading. Stack gained asChild so the <ul> is a VStack rather than a second gap table. Filed bbk-u5p: CardListItem is unreachable through List.

Badge shipped: no variant, selected/unselected as states with aria-pressed, sizes 32/40/48, 18 tests, 8 stories, registry entry. Radius is half the minimum height rather than rounded-full, found by looking at a wrapped tag. Reviewed by all three.

SearchField — a real <input type=search> with the magnifier and a clear button, plus stories, tests and a registry entry. Marked browser-only per plan 3.8. Review found value being optional made the input uncontrolled and killed the clear button (now required), clearing dropped focus to body (now returns to the input), and the field had no hover feedback at all (now hover:bg-muted).

Text (SIZES, TONES, WEIGHTS, ALIGNS) and Stack (GAPS, ALIGNS, JUSTIFIES) now route every lookup through classFor, so a wrong guess warns instead of landing as an ignored attribute. classFor's value param widened to string | number for Stack's numeric gap keys. Seven table-driven tests, one per prop.
verify.sh now builds before it typechecks. tsconfig includes .next/types and next-env.d.ts, both generated by next build, so a cleared .next failed the gate and read as the change's fault.
